noProjects: No projects to quote on yet.
requestHint: The lines, and anything the coordinator needs to know.
issueHint: The number SMAC gave it. That is what issues it.
sendBackHint: What needs changing? The rep reads this.
cancelHint: It leaves the coordinator’s queue. Nothing is deleted.
acceptHint: Records the customer’s answer on the quotation. It does not change the project.
rejectHint: What did the customer say? A rejected quotation does not mark the project lost.
empty: No quotations yet. Request the first one with the button above.
emptyForCompany: No quotations for this company yet.
emptyForProject: No quotations for this project yet.
notesPlaceholder: Anything the coordinator needs to know
needsLines: A quotation needs at least one complete item.
notFound: That quotation is not there any more.
alreadyIssued: This quotation has already been issued — a change to it is a revision now.
notWaiting: This request is not waiting any more.
notIssued: The customer’s answer is recorded once the quotation has been issued.
notIssuedYet: This one has not been issued yet — edit the request instead of revising it.
sentBackTimes: {count, plural, one {sent back once} other {sent back # times}}
